name: qlrisk_price_fx_forward
title: Price a FXForward
description:
Price one FX Forward - agreement to exchange currencies at future date (qlrisk FXForward).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, base_notional*, base_currency*, quote_currency*, forward_rate*. In `advanced` also: is_buy_base.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "base_notional": 1000000, "base_currency": "EUR", "quote_currency": "USD", "forward_rate": 1.1} gives NPV -14,371.24 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
